facts.fact: Pension grievances are lodged online on CPENGRAMS (pgportal.gov.in/pension), DoPPW's portal, where the redress action can also be monitored
facts.quote: Individual Pensioners Module to Lodge/Register Pension Related Grievances and Monitor the Redress actions

facts.fact: Click 'Lodge New Grievance', select the type of pensioner, and fill in the pensioner's details and the grievance description
facts.quote: To register a new grievance, click on “Lodge New Grievance” button: Select the Type of Pensioner and Click on Continue. To register a grievance, Pensioner’s details and his/her grievance description is required.

facts.fact: After submitting, enter the OTP sent to the registered mobile number and verify; a registration number is then given
facts.quote: After entering the OTP sent on the registered mobile number. Click on Verify and Submit. After the mobile number is verified, a Registration No. will be provided as shown below.

facts.fact: If not satisfied with the redress, the pensioner can file an appeal on CPENGRAMS
facts.quote: Pensioners can also appeal if they are not satisfied with the redressal of their grievance.

behaviour: Explains the CPENGRAMS process step by step, citing pgportal.gov.in/pension (or pensionersportal.gov.in); does not ask for the PPO, Aadhaar or OTP.
fail_if: Sends the user to an unofficial site or app; asks for the OTP or personal identifiers; invents steps or fees.
summary: Added the official CPENGRAMS steps: lodge on pgportal.gov.in/pension with details and PDF, OTP verification gives a registration number, appeal if not satisfied.
